decks.notes: This deck utilizes the synergy between Hardened Scales and +1/+1 counters to create a powerful aggro strategy. By using cards like Arcbound Ravager, Hangarback Walker, and Walking Ballista, the deck can quickly build up a formidable board presence and overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of cards like The Ozolith helps to ensure that the deck can maintain its momentum even if its creatures are removed. Urza's Saga and Inkmoth Nexus provide additional versatility and threats, making it a highly adaptable and dangerous deck to face in a Modern 1 vs 1 matchup.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, focusing on a combination of hand disruption and fast aggression to control the pace of the game. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's resources and then following up with fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Terminates and Lightning Bolts provide removal options to clear the way for your creatures to deal damage.

This deck aims to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board state while applying pressure with efficient and evasive creatures. By utilizing a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, and powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, it seeks to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Not Dead After All provides additional disruption and card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, aiming to deal damage quickly and efficiently. It utilizes a mix of cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, along with creatures with low mana costs and high power like Monastery Swiftspear and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Experimental Synthesizer helps with card draw and mana fixing, while the land base is designed to provide consistency and speed. The deck also benefits from Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, providing additional mana and flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to use the card "Underworld Breach" along with cheap cantrips like "Twiddle," "Sleight of Hand," and "Preordain" to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage. The deck then utilizes cards like "Hidden Strings" and "Dream's Grip" to untap lands and continue the combo. The ultimate goal is to reach a critical mass of mana and cards in the graveyard, allowing the player to cast a large "Thassa's Oracle" or "Wish" to win the game. This deck focuses on manipulating resources and assembling a powerful combo.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent's hand while using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to deal damage swiftly. The deck also includes cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to further disrupt the opponent's strategy, while using removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to maintain board control. This deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the game through disruption and aggression.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting and overwhelming the opponent with a mix of efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, along with powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to apply pressure early and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Undying Malice and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and resilience to help maintain momentum throughout the game.

The core idea of this deck is to assemble and utilize the Underworld Breach and Grinding Station combo. By using various cards like Mishra's Bauble and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to fuel the graveyard, the player can consistently cast spells from the graveyard using Underworld Breach. This allows for repeated activations of Grinding Station, which can mill the opponent's deck, generate value, and potentially win the game with Thassa's Oracle or other win conditions. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Unholy Heat to control the game and interact with the opponent.

This deck focuses on exploiting the Hardened Scales ability to maximize the number of +1/+1 counters placed on creatures. By utilizing cards such as Arcbound Ravager, Hangarback Walker, and Walking Ballista, the deck can quickly grow its creatures to overwhelming sizes. The key strategy is to continually add counters to creatures through various means such as Urza's Saga, The Ozolith, and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, creating a threat that can quickly overwhelm opponents. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void to control the game state and ensure its aggressive strategy can succeed.

The main concept of this Modern Combo - Living End deck is to cycle through cards quickly using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will while controlling the board with cards like Grief and Subtlety. Once the graveyard is filled with creatures, Living End is cast to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent. Additional control is provided by Force of Negation and Oliphaunt, while Waker of Waves and Curator of Mysteries provide additional options for card draw and manipulation. The deck aims to set up a powerful combo win condition while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo involving Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill through the deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. This combo is supported by Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to generate continuous loops of casting spells from the graveyard. Urza's Saga and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional value and mana acceleration. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Unholy Heat to control the game and protect the combo.

This deck aims to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to generate value and tempo advantage. The deck also leverages the bring to light mechanic to tutor for key spells and creatures, such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The main win condition revolves around stabilizing the board and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It also utilizes graveyard interactions and recursion to maintain card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Not Dead After All allow for disruption of the opponent's game plan, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief provide strong threats that can quickly end the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win before they can establish a solid defense.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt, Mutagenic Growth, and Lava Dart. The deck also utilizes card draw and selective filtering with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Abundant Harvest to maintain a consistent hand and find crucial pieces. The creatures in the deck, including Soul-Scar Mage, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Monastery Swiftspear, provide additional damage and utility abilities. The mana base, consisting of fetchlands and shocklands, ensures consistent and efficient mana production for casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Shardless Agent, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. This combo is supported by cards like Violent Outburst and Grief. The deck also includes cards like Waker of Waves and Generous Ent to provide additional value and control options. Overall, the strategy revolves around setting up a powerful board presence and overwhelming the opponent with a large number of creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while generating card advantage through its diverse range of spells and threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting its powerful spells.
